text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Another massacre in Medea, 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers: 32 villagers hacked to death on Wednesday by about 30 "terrorists" armed with knifes, hatchets and shotguns.
- European Union Commission senior official Manuel Marin to visit Algiers on April 15.
- Party leaders hold meetings to sound out mood ahead of parliamentary elections due on June 5.
- President Zeroual installs independent committee to supervise parliamentary elections.
